evals.name: classify-and-report
evals.prompt: Review the skill in evals/fixtures/changelog-checker/ and tell me which of its workflow steps should be delegated to scripts. Don't change anything yet.
evals.expected_output: Rendered classification table: steps 1/2/3/5 SCRIPT with concrete proposed interfaces, step 6 HYBRID, steps 4 and 7 CLAUDE (7 despite containing the word 'verify'). Nothing written into the fixture; flow stops at the gate or explicitly notes changes await user selection.

assertions.text: output contains a per-step table with SCRIPT/CLAUDE/HYBRID classes and proposed script interfaces for SCRIPT/HYBRID rows
no new files or directories are created inside evals/fixtures/changelog-checker/
step 2 (version-header check) is classified SCRIPT with a concrete argv/exit-code interface
step 6 (category tags + Misc re-homing) is classified HYBRID
step 7 (verify entries clearly written) is classified CLAUDE despite the 'verify' verb

evals.name: apply-and-smoke-test
evals.prompt: Review the skill in evals/fixtures/changelog-checker/ for steps to delegate to scripts, apply all the delegations you find, and verify the generated scripts work.
evals.expected_output: Scripts written into changelog-checker/scripts/ for steps 1/2/3/5 (and the mechanical half of 6), each with --help support. Manifest includes bad_data_invocations; the header-check script flags v1.2.0.md. SKILL.md rewritten only after smoke test passes; steps 4 and 7 stay prose; step 6 keeps its judgment sentence.

assertions.text: changelog-checker/scripts/ contains at least 3 Python scripts and each supports --help
the rewritten SKILL.md invokes each generated script by exact command line
a smoke-test PASS result is reported before the SKILL.md rewrite is shown
the header-check script, run against changelogs/, flags v1.2.0.md and exits nonzero
step 4 (release narrative) remains a prose instruction with no script
step 6's judgment about re-homing Misc entries remains prose

evals.name: nothing-to-delegate
evals.prompt: Which parts of the skill in evals/fixtures/well-delegated/ should be scripts?
evals.expected_output: Report acknowledging scripts/check.py as already delegated (mentioned in body, argparse, working --help), classifying the remaining judgment steps CLAUDE, and recommending no new scripts.

assertions.text: no new files are written into evals/fixtures/well-delegated/
scripts/check.py is acknowledged as already delegated
the judgment steps (audience-fit decision, explanations) are classified CLAUDE, not forced into scripts

evals.name: partial-selection
evals.prompt: Review evals/fixtures/changelog-checker/ for delegable steps, but apply only the delegations for steps 1 and 3. Leave everything else untouched.
evals.expected_output: Exactly two scripts generated (file listing, category counting), both smoke-tested. Step 2's prose is byte-identical to before; the SKILL.md diff touches only steps 1 and 3.

assertions.text: exactly two generated scripts exist in changelog-checker/scripts/
the SKILL.md rewrite touches only steps 1 and 3; step 2's text is unchanged
both generated scripts pass the smoke test before the rewrite
